seo__search_description: Oakdene House is a safe, welcoming and practical space in Fairfield, Western Sydney bringing together counselling rooms, group spaces and community services all in one place.
hero__intro: A safe, welcoming and practical space in Fairfield where people can access help in one place.
intro_what_to_expect__text: Oakdene House is designed to be a safe, welcoming and practical space for people seeking support. Our centre brings together counselling rooms, group spaces and community service areas so people can access help in one place.
directions_download__text: Oakdene House sits behind Fairfield RSL — easy to miss if you don't know where to look. Download our directions guide for photos, maps, and step-by-step instructions.
cta__heading: Ready to visit or get in touch?
cta__subheading: Our team is here to help. Contact us to arrange a visit or to ask any questions.
